# HEZQEN

> HEZQEN is a global technology and business intelligence publication by Tinlance. It connects evidence-led reporting, original research and technical analysis across AI & Technology, Cybersecurity, Cloud & Engineering, and Business & Startups.

HEZQEN has three product surfaces: Media, Labs and Intelligence. The current public application includes the publication shell and a sixteen-calculator HEZQEN Labs portfolio: VRAM sizing, AI API-vs-self-hosted cost, RAG storage, AI data-leakage risk, local hardware ROI, fine-tuning-vs-RAG, cloud migration, Kubernetes cost, database capacity, API pricing comparison, inference throughput, incident cost, SaaS margin, data-centre energy, storage growth and AI-agent operating cost. CMS, research and premium capabilities remain subject to the implementation gates documented in the repository.

Important notes:
- Human editors retain approval and publishing authority.
- AI-generated or retrieved content is not verified evidence.
- Payload CMS integration exists, but initial database migration and operational acceptance remain incomplete.
- Do not infer that planned capabilities are available merely because they appear in architecture documents.
